description: This Java source file contains the implementation of the HibernateTemplateDAO class, which provides database operations for Template objects using Hibernate ORM framework. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting Template entities, as well as setting the Hibernate session factory.

classes.name: HibernateTemplateDAO
classes.description: Implementation of TemplateDAO interface, managing CRUD operations for Template objects via Hibernate.

methods.name: setSessionFactory
methods.description: Sets the Hibernate SessionFactory used for database operations.

methods.name: getTemplates
methods.description: Retrieves all Template objects from the database.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a specific Template by its ID.

methods.name: getTemplatesByName
methods.description: Finds templates matching a specific name.

methods.name: createTemplate
methods.description: Creates a new Template in the database.

methods.name: updateTemplate
methods.description: Updates an existing Template or creates it if it does not exist.

methods.name: deleteTemplate
methods.description: Deletes a Template from the database.
